node.statement: For n=1 and Z in S_P, compressed-product-display applied in the diagonal compressed corner gives ||Z^dagger dot Z-Z^dagger Z|| <= K_dot*(delta+epsilon)*||Z^dagger||*||Z|| for a universal K_dot and sufficiently small delta+epsilon. The involution axiom gives ||Z^dagger||=||Z||, and e=delta+epsilon by def-hcb-datum, proving the displayed level-one estimate.
